scope: Logical output overwrite proof, no arithmetic or kernel change
dispatch: EncodeVision validates operation-specific rows/columns and calls EncodeStateKernel10 with outRows*outColumns. Modes0/2/3/4/5/6/9 remain scalar vision_op; specialized switches choose1/7/8/10 only.

admitted_modes.2: Each logical element assigns GELU tanh
admitted_modes.3: Each logical element assigns GELU erf approximation
admitted_modes.4: Each logical element assigns merge permutation input
admitted_modes.5: Each logical element assigns input plus indexed positional sum
admitted_modes.6: Each logical element assigns RoPE result or copies V tail
admitted_modes.9: Each logical element assigns flatten permutation input

liveness: All a/b/arguments conservative reads; full one-writer proof, singleton standard tracked FP32 buffers, protected weights/root/input/output/aliases, strict oldlast<newfirst unchanged. No same-op alias permitted.
